appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Customize the appearance of the application to your liking.

languages.title: Language
languages.description: Select the language for the application interface.

standard.title: Standard themes
standard.description: Choose between light and dark mode.

custom.title: Custom themes
custom.description: Choose between different more custom themes.

explorer.title: Themes browser
explorer.description: Explore custom themes and choose the one you like!

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Advanced options for development and debugging.

devmode.title: Developer mode
devmode.description: Enable "Developer" page with advanced features for debugging.

clear_cache.title: Clear cache
clear_cache.description: Clear application request cache to get fresh data

success.title: Cache cleared
success.message: The application request cache has been cleared successfully.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your data, saved accounts and logging out.

personal_data.title: Personal data
personal_data.description: Download a PDF with the data Synergia stores about you.

saved.title: Saved accounts
saved.empty: No saved accounts. Tick "Save this account" when signing in.

logout.title: Log out
logout.description: Ends the session. The default account won't sign in by itself until the app is restarted.

translation.title: Translation
translation.description: Translate messages, descriptions and subject names written by the school into the app language.
translation.privacy: Translation runs on your device - texts are never sent anywhere. Names of people are not translated.
translation.polish: The app is in Polish, so school content needs no translation. Switch the app language above to use it.

engine.none: Translation is not available in this browser (desktop Chrome 138+ or the mobile app is needed).

models.title: Language models
models.unused: Not used by the current language · ~30 MB
models.delete_in_use: Translation will stop working until the model is downloaded again (~30 MB).
models.delete_unused: The model is not used by the current app language. It frees about 30 MB.
models.delete_failed: Could not delete the {{language}} model - it may be built into the system.
models.browser_managed: The browser manages its own models - they can't be listed or deleted here.

auto.title: Translate automatically
auto.description: Show school content translated everywhere, lists included. Each detail view still has "Show original".

translation.error: Could not prepare the translation. Check your connection and try again.

analytics.title: Usage statistics
analytics.description: Send anonymous information about which screens are opened (Firebase Analytics). No diary data, names or login.

disable.title: Turn off statistics?
disable.message: Anonymous statistics show which features are used most and what is worth improving. They help the app keep developing - if you can, leave them on.
disable.note: Statistics contain no grades, messages, names or login details. You can turn them back on at any time.
